body.p: Claims 1, 5-11, and 16-24 will be pending after entry of the present paper. Claims 1-15 were previously pending with claims 12-15 withdrawn. Claims 2-4 and 12-15 are canceled without disclaimer of or prejudice to the subject matter contained therein. New claims 16-24 are added. Claims 1, 10, and 11 is amended as set forth above. Applicant requests reconsideration of the present application in light of the foregoing amendments and following remarks.

Applicant appreciates the indication that claim 2-4 would be allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims. By this Reply, independent claim 1 has been amended to incorporate the indicated allowable subject matter of claim 2. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully submits that the rejection of claims 1, 5-9, and 11 as being anticipated under 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(1) over U.S. Patent Publication No. 2022/0106057 Al to Mukai et al. ("Mukai") and the rejection of claim 10 as being unpatentable over Mukai un view of U.S. Patent No. 6,268,702 to Fleck ("Fleck") have been overcome and claims 1 and 5-11 stand in condition for allowance.

Also, by this Reply, claims 16-24 are added. Independent claim 16, which recites subject matter similar to original claim 1, has been amended to incorporate the indicated allowable subject matter of claim 3. Claims 17-19 depend in independent claim 16 and claim subject matter similar to claim 4-11. Accordingly, Applicants respectfully submits that claims 16-24 also stand in condition for allowance.

In view of the above remarks and amendments, Applicant respectfully submits that all pending claims are in condition for allowance. The Examiner is invited to telephone the undersigned at the Examiner's convenience, if doing so will further prosecution of the subject application. The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any fees that may be required or credit any overpayment to Deposit Account No. 192814. This statement does NOT authorize charge of the issue fee.
